violation_type.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Statement on Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.3309(a))
violation_type.short_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Statement on Enrollment Agreement
violation_type.typical_finding: There is one child that brings meals from home. There is no statement on file stating the parent is providing meals or that the center is not responsible for the nutritional value of the food the parents are providing.

finding_variants.text: There is one child that brings meals from home. There is no statement on file stating the parent is providing meals or that the center is not responsible for the nutritional value of the food the parents are providing.

The enrollment agreement did not have the following information nor an addendum containing the following information: 1) Is choosing to provide the child's lunch from home; and  (2) Understands the child-care center is not responsible for its nutritional value or for meeting the child's daily food needs during lunch.
The parents who provide meals did not have the signed statement that they understand the operation is not responsible for its nutritional value.
The operation mandates some parents to provide their children's lunch although an acknowledgement was not signed in the initial enrollment agreement to indicate this.

Based on information gathered, it was determined the operation encourages parents to provide meals and snacks for children enrolled, but has not included a statement in its enrollment agreement and has not added an addendum explaining that if a parent is choosing to provide meals and/or snacks from home,  the operation is not responsible for its nutritional value or meeting daily food needs of the child.
One child did not have a statement on file that parent would provide meals for child.
